content: Kuzingila mu mwini
Sokululenu mbandu ya Nzambi, mudyambu lwenina bana batondama
Dyatilenu mu lungongu, bwosu buna phi kátuzola Kidisitu, mu kudilambula yandi-meni kwena Nzambi kikuma kya betu, hanga dikabu yi kimenga kya tsudi ya kitoku.
Benu lwenina bakwikidi ba Nzambi; yambulenu mbongi, mambu ma mvindu muna mitindu myandi myosu holo lukusu: lusungulamoku keti mbala mosi hana kati dya benu.
Ka mboti ku ni lwalubulaka ndinga za khadi, za buzoba holo za mvindu. Kaasi bulungi lwavutulaka matondu kwena Nzambi.
Mukuma, zayenu bwoku mboti ni, ka mutu mosi ku wisi dilambula ku kindumba, ku bizumba, ku lukusu -disongidila ni kufukamina nzambi za biteki -wabónga kizika muna Kipfumu kya Kidisitu yi kya Nzambi.
Ka mutu ku kaluhuna mu ndinga zakonda mupfunu: kikuma, muna mambu ma mutindu meni wawuna zisi kwisila khabu za Nzambi kwena batu babana.
Disongidila, lukalaku keti kima kimosi kya kimvuka yi bawu.
Kikuma, theti mu phipha lwákala; kaasi buthwena, mu kikhunda kyenu yi Pfumu, lwekina mwini
. Dyatilenu hanga bana ba mwini,
mukuma kibundu kya mwini kyenina: buweti, masonga, kyedika.
Zayakenu mu kubangumuna mambu mana misi sephidisa Nzambi.
Lukotaku mu mihangu mya mu phipha
; kaasi benu tungululenumyoku.
Kikuma, mambu mana bisi sala mu kitsweki, tsoni menina mu kuzonzilama.
Kinga mana moosu, yuka ni matunguluki kedi, hanga malubuki ha tseki.
Mukuma mambu moosu mana matungulukini, mekina mwini. Yi hana kazonzidi bwabu:
Yi hana ni kebenu mu ndyatidi yenu. Lukalaku hanga bazoba, kaasi hanga batu badimuka.
Sadilenu bukheti tangwa dina dyenina ku thwala ya benu, mukuma bilumbu bya mbi byenina.
Lukalaku hanga bazoba, kaasi syenu ngolu mu kubakisa buna lwenina luzolu lwa Pfumu.
Luzelaku vinu, kikuma kwiti dyandi dyisi nata ku mvwalangani; kaasi kalenu babasa yi Kitembu Kyatoma.
Dihekenu kikesa benu yi benu mu nzila ya mikunga yi mikunga mya khembu yi mina mya Kitembu; yimbilenu, kumisenu phi Pfumu muna mbundu
yenu yosu.
Kosu tangwa yi muna mambu moosu, vutulenu matondu kwena yandi wenina Nzambi yi Tata wetu, muna zina dya Pfumu wetu Yesu Kidisitu.
Bakhetu yi bayakala
Dilemvwakilenu benu yi benu kikuma kya bweya mwena Kidisitu.
Yi hana ni bakhetu, lemvukenu kwena bayakala benu bwosu lwisi lemvuka kwena Pfumu.
Mukuma, yakala kenina pfumu wa mukhetu, bwosu kenina Kidisitu Pfumu wa Dibundu dina dyenina lutu lwandi, amana yandi phi wenina Muhuludi wa dyawu.
Disongidila, bulungi bakhetu balemvuka kwena bayakala ba bawu bwosu buna dyisi lemvuka Dibundu kwena Kidisitu.
Bayakala, zolenu bakhetu benu bwosu kázola Kidisitu Dibundu, amana wáditambika yandi meni kikuma kya dyawu;
ndangu katomisadya, mu kusemisadya mu mamba yi mu Ndinga.
Kázola ni Dibundu meni dina dyamonika ku thwala ya yandi, yi khembu, dyakonda mvindu, keti tona, keti kifu kimosi. Kaasi dyakala dyatoma amana dyakonda kifu.
Phila mosi ni bayakala bafweti zola bakhetu ba bawu bwosu bisi zola lutu lwa bawu meni. Wuna wazola mukhetu wandi, kisi dizola yandi meni.
Kikuma heku mutu wábwisa kedi lutu lwa yandi meni; kaasi kisilwa disa amana kisilwa yidika, bwosu kisibwa sala Kidisitu kikuma kya Dibundu,
kikuma betu thwenina bitini bya lutu lwandi.
«Yi hana ni yakala kasísa tata wandi yi ngudi wandi ndangu kakhundakana kwena mukhetu wandi, amana bawu bodi bakítuka lutu lumosi
Diswekamu dimosi dya mbuta dyenina hana; meni nzonzi ni matadidi Kidisitu yi Dibundu.
Yi hakana ni, mosi-mosi wa benu kazola mukhetu wandi hanga yandi meni, amana mukhetu kazitisa yakala dyandi.
